description: The rule of the boxes of a workbook (contracts/README.md, section 12): from the boxes of a page, in the task's order, and its strokes to the box each stroke fills, or none, the draft, and the filled boxes with the IDs of their strokes. canvas's vectors/boxes.json at its tag v0.1.2.

cases.name: edge-digits
cases.description: Ten answers of one digit 50 high, pushed past the right, the left, the top and the bottom of their boxes by 0 to 20 units: each is its box's. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: edge-signs
cases.description: «4», «5», «+», «×» and «=», each two strokes, pushed past an edge of their boxes by 6 to 14 units: one stroke of each may stand outside, and the character is its box's. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: numbers
cases.description: Answers of two digits, 36, 44 and 50 high, moved up to 20 units right or 12 left: the last digit of the widest stands past the box's edge. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: mixed-numbers
cases.description: The page of many kinds of lines: answers of one to three digits 40 to 60 high — «635» and «135» as wide as their boxes — and a «<». The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: fractions
cases.description: Fractions in two storeys, digits 30 to 44 high and bars 28 to 80 long, and two bars of 120 and 140, wider than their boxes; a «<» and a «=» answer the comparisons. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: inline
cases.description: Fractions written in a line with «/», 36 to 44 high: «4/10» at 40 is 109 wide, past both sides of its box. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: comparisons
cases.description: Comparison signs 20 to 50 high as the answers of ten lines; the «=» of the ninth stands across the bottom edge of its box, its lower bar 4 units past it. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: neighbours
cases.description: Seven boxes 32 apart, five in a row and two in the row below: each answer drifts 4 to 14 units into the gap toward a box beside or the row below, and stays its own box's. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: across
cases.description: A line from the middle of one box to the middle of the next is no answer; a tall «1» running 14 units below its box is its own; a scribble over two boxes is either; a line from the row above through a box and below it is the draft. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: draft
cases.description: A column sum between the columns of boxes, a «7» 8 to 48 units right of four boxes and dots 8 and 16 off a box are the draft; dots 2 and 4 off it are either; a dot in its corner is its own. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: rings
cases.description: A ring round the answer within its box is its own; a ring round a whole box is either; a ring round the whole line, its text and its box, is the draft. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: crossed
cases.description: A line through a whole line and a cross over another are the draft; an answer crossed out in its box and the right one written beside it, up to 25 units past the edge, are the box's. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: erased
cases.description: An answer erased and written again, a page cleared and the clearing undone, and the last digit of an answer erased and written anew: only the strokes the page shows count. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: edge-digits-every-2
cases.description: Ten answers of one digit 50 high, pushed past the right, the left, the top and the bottom of their boxes by 0 to 20 units: each is its box's. The points of a stroke are every 2 units along it.

cases.name: edge-signs-every-2
cases.description: «4», «5», «+», «×» and «=», each two strokes, pushed past an edge of their boxes by 6 to 14 units: one stroke of each may stand outside, and the character is its box's. The points of a stroke are every 2 units along it.

cases.name: fractions-every-2
cases.description: Fractions in two storeys, digits 30 to 44 high and bars 28 to 80 long, and two bars of 120 and 140, wider than their boxes; a «<» and a «=» answer the comparisons. The points of a stroke are every 2 units along it.

cases.name: comparisons-every-2
cases.description: Comparison signs 20 to 50 high as the answers of ten lines; the «=» of the ninth stands across the bottom edge of its box, its lower bar 4 units past it. The points of a stroke are every 2 units along it.

cases.name: edges
cases.description: Boxes of their own — 100 × 100, 120 × 80, and two that overlap — and dots and lines on and a tenth past each widened edge and the limit, rounding onto an edge, and strokes two overlapping boxes may both take: the more points held, then the earlier box.

cases.name: seeded-1
cases.description: A workbook of seed 1 on the page fractions-ten: an answer in every box, and draft 8 to 48 units off the boxes. The points of a stroke are at its corners.

cases.name: seeded-2
cases.description: A workbook of seed 2 on the page mixed: an answer in every box, and draft 8 to 48 units off the boxes. The points of a stroke are at its corners.
